entries.en:
Did you know there is a woman who has kept her flower shop running through these strange events?
Takako Kobayashi, who runs a flower shop near the Sakuramachi intersection in Sakura Ward, has had her shop destroyed not once but twice during this series of strange events. At a loss, she considered giving up on everything, but she decided she couldn't quit now if she wanted to raise her son into a fine adult, and resolved to keep the flower shop going.

entries.en:
Amid the strange events, the struggles of police officers continue. Naoko Kuribayashi, a patrol officer in Sakura Ward, is one of them. She worked desperately to guide evacuations, but the endless string of unimaginable situations made her painfully aware of her own powerlessness. She was also reportedly troubled by her superior's cosplay hobby.
These strange events instantly shattered the everyday lives that so many people had kept in delicate balance. It may be some time yet before people can afford to look back on what happened.

entries.en: The object attached to the red giant's head appears to have been a huge boomerang-shaped weapon. The giant fought with it in hand, but dropped it to the ground after being hit by the monster's attack. Tamotsu Yamamoto, a shop owner who says he measured the weapon lying on the ground, said, "The silver weapon was more than seven meters long."

entries.en: The battle between the red giant and the red monster also dealt a heavy blow to a department store in Sakura Ward. On top of damage to the building, merchandise was destroyed, and store manager Fujio Fujiwara says the losses will be enormous.

entries.en:
This series of strange events caused major damage in Sakura Ward, Miyato City. Amid it all, some people spent the night inside a damaged building and made it through the crisis. Takao Yonehara and Yuki Nagahama are two such people, who stayed close to each other despite their fear and safely greeted the morning.

Q: Didn't you think it was all over?

Yonehara: I believed we would definitely be saved. That's why I kept encouraging her never to give up.
Nagahama: Because he was with me, I never once felt like giving up. I was determined to survive.

Perhaps refusing to give up is the greatest power for opening the way to tomorrow.

entries.en:
Risa Kashiwagi (real name: Reiko Kamio), who had been active as a journalist, has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder and kidnapping.
Kashiwagi wrote for magazines and web media and had won strong support from young people.
As CEO of the weapons consulting firm W&P, she received investment from major U.S. arms maker M and, through deals with defense agencies, built a company with annual sales of hundreds of billions of yen in just a few years.

She had worked as a journalist under the name Risa Kashiwagi since her student days, and this arrest revealed that the head of one of Japan's largest weapons consulting firms and the popular journalist beloved by young people were the same person. Her young admirers have been left shaken.

Since Kamio and other company executives died in these strange events, attention had turned to who would succeed her. Company M, a major shareholder, held an extraordinary shareholders' meeting and put forward a motion to close the business, which passed, and W&P's dissolution was decided.

Kamio had also worked as a journalist under the pen name Risa Kashiwagi since her student days. Reportedly, only executives of W&P and U.S. company M knew that Risa Kashiwagi and Reiko Kamio were the same person.

It has come to light that the luxury overseas beach resort "Southern Island Hideaway" is in danger of being submerged.
When the resort's manager went out to the shore in the morning, the sea level had risen more than one meter, leaving the beach and the low piers underwater. This has led to a wave of cancellations from guests with reservations, dealing a heavy blow to the operating company.
Among investors, speculation suspecting a link to the giant creature incidents in Miyato City has spread, along with rumors that the resort will be completely submerged, and its value has plummeted.

entries.en:
It has come to light that the luxury overseas beach resort "Southern Island Hideaway" has received the highest rating ever, six stars, from "Monthly GZ Resort," a magazine that rates lodgings around the world.
The resort was founded by Mr. Mikawa of Miyato City and has been highly rated by wealthy guests from many countries (management rights have since been transferred to another person).
Mr. Dawson, an investor who has stayed there, said, "The beautiful beach is wonderful, of course, but the fossil-digging activity is a blast. I'll never forget the thrill when an enormous fossil turned up."
Mr. Mikawa was caught up in the giant creature incidents that began yesterday and his whereabouts are unknown.

The giant creature incidents now striking Miyato City have harmed many residents, destroyed buildings and roads, and left deep scars. They have also cast various shadows over the survivors.
Mr. Nito, a firefighter at the Sakura Ward Fire Station in Miyato City, said, "I was rescuing people from collapsed buildings. But the giant creatures suddenly fire beams, so I was more cautious than necessary and couldn't act the way I wanted. Because of that, there were people we couldn't rescue in time. Looking back, I think I should have gone to help them. If only I'd had a little more composure and courage..."
Desperate rescue efforts are still underway across Miyato City, but there remains a shortage of personnel.

entries.en:
The giant creature incidents now striking Miyato City have harmed many residents, destroyed buildings and roads, and left deep scars. They have also cast various shadows over the survivors.
Mr. Nakahara (pseudonym), a university student living near Suzuran Avenue in Miyato City, saw his younger brother attacked by the flock of flying monsters that appeared that day.
"My brother's in middle school. We saw flames rising over by the avenue, so we went to look. He ran ahead, and the moment he reached the avenue, a monster came down from the sky and crushed him."
The monster reportedly approached Nakahara while gripping his brother in its feet.
"I thought I had to save him, but I didn't want that monster to catch me. I ran without looking back, ducked into a narrow alley, and crouched there the whole time."
Nakahara is not alone; many people in Miyato City have been left with emotional scars.

entries.en:
A social media post by TV personality Hiroo Akino, who evacuated from the giant creature that appeared in Sakura Ward, Miyato City today, has drawn criticism. Akino has since posted an apology and deleted the original post.
When the giant creature appeared, Akino was with several staff members from his agency, who protected him as he fled to a safe distance. There he realized one of the staff had been left behind and posted about it on social media. Criticism focused on his reply to a reader who wrote "Let's go back and help!": "I can't go back somewhere dangerous now. Besides, then they'd have saved me for nothing."
Akino later apologized, posting, "I was shaken by tremendous fear and made an inappropriate post. I'm sorry," and deleted the original.

entries.en:
Today, a flock of flying monsters that appeared on Suzuran Avenue in Miyato City attacked many people.
Amid this, Miyato Bus hastily used its buses to evacuate residents, and many people successfully escaped as a result.
However, the bus scheduled to leave last was attacked by the monsters. Its driver, Mr. Hamajima (pseudonym), miraculously survived.
"I was watching the monsters and trying to get as many residents on board as I could. But in the end a monster pulled the bus over, and many people were attacked. If only I'd noticed the monster approaching sooner..."
Hamajima says he still can't get the cries of the flying monsters attacking the bus out of his head.

Koma has since posted a comment on his website: "I apologize for a remark that caused misunderstanding. I did not mean to make light of the victims."

A talk show featuring a famous TV personality was scheduled to be held today in a room of a building in Miyato City's downtown, but a giant creature's heat-ray attack struck the building directly, killing 10 people and injuring 47.
The event's organizer left saying, "It's not my responsibility," and his whereabouts are unknown.
The building was a bookstore in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, where about 100 people had gathered for a talk show celebrating the publication of a book by TV personality Miyuko Takagi.
Police are questioning people about whether there were problems securing evacuation routes for the event.

entries.en:
After a photo weekly published pictures of voice actress Chinami Fuyuhara leaving the apartment of popular actor Koya Mizusaki, Mizusaki released a comment through his agency.

--------------------
I sincerely apologize for causing a public stir over a private matter.
I met Chinami Fuyuhara when I made a guest appearance in the animated film "Sugochikku Mirorin: The Eternal School Trip," and she gave me all sorts of advice about voice acting. She is one of my close friends with whom I can be completely at ease. There is no truth whatsoever to what the weekly magazine wrote.
Once again, I apologize to all my fans and everyone concerned for the trouble I have caused.
--------------------

In response, Chinami Fuyuhara's agency commented, "We understand that they are good friends."

At around 2:30 a.m. today, as strange events occurred across the area, Miyato City radio station Radio Sky Garden (RSG) held a fans-only live show for its popular late-night radio program "Midnight Sky Garden."
Program producer Mr. Shiroshita said, "Of course we intended to cancel, but fans came for the live show even amid those strange events, and we changed our minds. At a time like this, we wanted to use radio to do a live broadcast and encourage our listeners."
Midnight Sky Garden is a popular program hosted by singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura and broadcast nationwide from RSG.

entries.en:
Late tonight, many people witnessed a fierce battle between a red Angel that appeared in Sumire Ward, Miyato City, and a giant humanoid weapon that was deployed against it.
The humanoid weapon first fired a Gatling gun, then, after putting some distance between them, equipped knife-like weapons in both hands and charged at the red Angel.
Witnesses also saw that a cable connecting the humanoid weapon's back to the launch facility on the road where it was deployed had been severed. Military journalist Mr. Misatoya, an expert on weapons, said, "I don't know the details, but wasn't that a cable supplying energy? If so, the humanoid weapon may have been in a very dangerous state."

entries.en:
The red Angel incident that struck Sumire Ward, Miyato City, late tonight has caused major damage to a travel agency with an office in the ward.
The battle between the red Angel and the giant humanoid weapon has reportedly caused heavy damage to nearby buildings and roads. Office manager Taro Toyama laments, "Not only that, but in the chaos my love of cosplay was exposed, and now my staff keep their distance from me. If only those strange events hadn't happened..."
Toyama also earnestly said, "I hope it becomes a workplace where everyone accepts you, even if you love cosplay, even if you keep cosplay costumes in your work locker."

entries.en:
Mr. Miyoshi, a firefighter with the Sumire Fire Station in Miyato City, says that after witnessing the battle between the huge red Angel and the humanoid weapon that day, he lost his composure, realized his own powerlessness, and fell into despair.
Miyoshi said, "Seeing those enormous things, unlike anything I'd ever seen, fighting so fiercely, I felt painfully how small and powerless I was, and I was in shock. But a firefighter from another station who was at the scene encouraged me, and I was able to pull myself together and do what I could."
That firefighter reportedly left without giving a name.
There is no information that any such firefighter belonged to the crews dispatched to the scene at the time, leaving Miyoshi puzzled.

entries.en:
Ryoko Mizunuma, a student in the Faculty of Oceanography at Miyato University, was worn out by days of studying and part-time work.
She dreamed of becoming an oceanographer but couldn't balance paying her tuition with time for research, and was on the verge of giving up.
"But then that person appeared in front of me while I was exhausted. They told me about Dr. Hitomi Fukazawa, the oceanographer I admire. What a coincidence, I thought. No, I thought it was fate."
She was so exhausted that she doesn't remember what the person was like. But because of this, she vowed not to give up on becoming an oceanographer.

Oceanographer Dr. Fukazawa had an accident late tonight during an ocean survey aboard the observation ship Shibazakura and is missing.

entries.en:
Late tonight, a body was found in a city bus that was burning on a street in Sumire Ward, Miyato City. The body has been confirmed to be the bus's driver, Kazuhiko Saito (57).
The scene is where the red Angel appeared, and he is believed to have died after being struck by some impact during the battle between the red Angel and the giant humanoid weapon. There were no other victims on the bus, and Saito is thought to have been left behind while guiding others to evacuate.
Saito's daughter Madoka grieves, "I had just sent him a letter asking him to come see his grandchild. If only I'd gone to see him sooner."

entries.en: ＜Reporter's Eye＞ The Strange Events and the Lovers
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k113; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Late tonight, Sumire Ward in Miyato City was attacked by a huge red Angel. The damage was severe, centered on Radio Station Street, and there are many victims.
Shortly before the red Angel appeared, there were lovers on the street, speaking of their love.
With damage across Miyato City, starting with the giant alien incident in Sakura Ward, I think I looked at them with some irritation, thinking, "At a time like this?"
But afterward, this whole area became a mountain of rubble. I was desperate to photograph the red Angel, but all the while, I kept thinking about those lovers.
Eventually, after the red Angel was repelled by the giant humanoid weapon and things calmed down a little, I went back to where the two had been, but no one was there.
Are they safe? Are they escaping, thinking of each other? Can their love endure something like the strange events of these giant shadows?
I felt deeply sad that the everyday life in which two perfectly ordinary people could naturally speak of their love has grown so distant.

entries.en: The "Eno-Moya War" Begins?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k115; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Chocolate snacks are a common sight at convenience stores and supermarkets. Among them, "Enoki Village" and "Moyashi Town" are classic best-sellers, but a "war" has reportedly broken out among fans over these products.
Of course, it's not a bloody conflict, but more of a lighthearted game. Fans mainly use social media to make humorous appeals for whether they prefer "Enoki Village" or "Moyashi Town."
When we asked the manufacturer's PR department, they replied, "We're aware that Eno-Moya has become a hot topic. Even within our company, there's an Enoki faction and a Moyashi faction. We hope customers will buy whichever they prefer and recommend it to the people around them. By the way, I'm on the Moyashi side."

And according to the Eno-Moya summary site "Eno-Moya Warring States History," here's how the battle stood as of noon today.

Poll: Which do you prefer, "Enoki Village" or "Moyashi Town"?
　Enoki Village: 45%
　Moyashi Town: 40%

entries.en:
Amid the Gyaos incident in Miyato City, two people had a miraculous reunion.
Yoko (28, pseudonym), an office worker fleeing the Gyaos, suffered a serious leg injury and managed to escape into the PANSIE Department Store, but the wound worsened until she could no longer walk. Then Shinichi (38, pseudonym), a former doctor who had also fled the Gyaos, appeared and gave her first aid. As they talked, they were astonished to learn that they were siblings who had been separated long ago. Shinichi said, "I'm glad I could treat her in that situation. But to think it was my sister... It's complicated to think we might never have met if the Gyaos hadn't appeared."

entries.en:
During the Gyaos attack on Miyato City, a Miyato Bus driver reportedly helped evacuate residents.
A driver and police officers who happened to be at the scene guided residents onto the bus, allowing dozens of people to escape from Suzuran Avenue. Mr. Miyata, who drove the escaping bus, said, "I was completely focused. But when I think there may have been people I couldn't save..." and choked up.

entries.en: It has been announced that "The Tale of the Last Sword," the hit novel that has sold one billion copies worldwide, will be made into a video game. Details are undecided, but the genre is said to be action-adventure, letting players become part of the world of "The Tale of the Last Sword" and go on adventures. Preorder bonuses include figures of Troll and Isabella and a life-size soft vinyl "Last Sword." Any Saiken fan will want to get their hands on it.

entries.en:
Miyato Cinema, a movie theater in Miyato City, is drawing attention as the heart of Miyato City's recovery. Miyato Cinema is the oldest movie theater in Miyato City and has been operating for 70 years.
Miyato City has suffered major damage from the giant creature incident that occurred tonight, but Miyato Cinema has opened its doors to people who lost their homes, showing movies for free and soothing people's weary hearts. Mr. Araya, who has taken refuge at Miyato Cinema, said, "A giant creature destroyed my house and I didn't know what to do, but I heard this place was open, so I came. I'm happy I got to see 'Sugochikku Mirorin: The Blank Lunch Period,' which I'd missed."

entries.en:
Shortly after 6:00 p.m. today, two giant aliens, about 40 meters tall, suddenly appeared near the Sakuramachi intersection on National Route 3 in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, and began fighting. The two giants fought using optical weapons and martial arts.

According to Sachiko Tomisaka, a resident of the ward who watched the fight up close, the two looked very much alike when they first appeared, but after one of them fell on its backside onto a pedestrian bridge, its appearance changed.

The glowing giant whose appearance did not change was at one point kicked away and losing to the other giant, but it reportedly turned the tables near the West Azami intersection.

entries.en:
The giant alien that disguised itself as the giant of light and destroyed the city called itself Alien Zarab and stated that it had come to Earth from planet Zarab to establish friendly relations with Earth.
It is estimated to be about 40 meters tall and weigh about 20,000 tons.
Alien Zarab first appeared in Sakura Ward looking almost exactly like the giant of light (Ultraman), and kept destroying nearby buildings and cars with a bullet-like light weapon fired from its fingertips (some experts call it the "Energy Vulcan").
Ultraman forced it to reveal its true form, showing that the attacker had been Alien Zarab.

Several mysteries remain, such as why Alien Zarab, which came to build friendly relations, destroyed the city.
Mr. Watanabe (pseudonym), an office worker who commutes to the area from Sumire Ward, angrily said, "I trusted Alien Zarab, so I'm very disappointed. Why did it disguise itself as Ultraman and destroy the city? If the goal was to ruin Ultraman's reputation, that's unforgivable."

entries.en:
A burglar broke into the Aokiba-cho police box in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, and stole one female police officer's uniform. According to police, the break-in occurred while officers were guiding evacuations when the giant aliens appeared in the city.
The culprit broke the door of the reception room and stole the uniform from a wardrobe in the break room. Police are treating it as a theft and collecting eyewitness information.

Senior Officer Yanai, who was at the police box at the time, said while spitting with fervor, "I didn't notice the door being broken at all. This must be the work of aliens. Why would aliens steal Officer Kuribayashi's female officer uniform? It's an outrage!"

The stolen item is a female police officer's uniform in size M. According to its owner, Officer Kuribayashi, it was brand new as of last week.
To the thief, Officer Kuribayashi said, "Losing a police uniform causes all kinds of trouble, so please give it back. If you return it, I'll give you a different private costume in exchange."

Police announced that passersby found hundreds of high-denomination bills fluttering through the air near the Sakuramachi intersection on National Route 3 in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, and turned them in as lost property.

The scene is where the giant aliens were fighting at the time, and the bills are believed to have come out of a building after the aliens destroyed it.

So far, no one has come forward as the owner. The fact that no owner has stepped forward despite so much money being scattered has fueled speculation that it may be the kind of cash that can't be shown in public.

entries.en:
Major convenience store chain Clover announced that its fried chicken sales for the March quarter rose to 160% of the previous year.

The company's fried chicken is sold under the "Karaage Minister" brand, with a wide range of flavors such as soy sauce, milk, and strawberry, as well as dessert-style varieties, making it popular with women too. The company is eager to keep offering innovative fried chicken that incorporates customer feedback.

Among fans, many posts speculate about the company's next fried chicken lineup, such as "Next up is marinated tuna flavor" and "It's got to be a dessert. If so, tiramisu fried chicken is very likely next," stirring up strange expectations.

entries.en:
Around 6:00 p.m. today, a G-Z Transit bus nearly caught up in the fight between giant aliens in Sakura Ward was able to evacuate all of its passengers safely thanks to the quick thinking of driver Yoichi Tawarada.

Passenger Seiji Fujita, a West Azami resident, said, "We were almost stepped on by a giant foot, but the driver controlled the bus skillfully and we got out safely. And the driver stayed on the bus guiding everyone until we'd all evacuated. He saved our lives."

entries.en: The Kaido Building in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, was destroyed by a giant alien. According to survivors at the scene, the alien thrust a huge hand into the building and threw the office into chaos with a telekinesis-like power.

entries.en:
Takako Kobayashi of Sakura Ward, who sold flowers on the street, had her shop destroyed by crowds fleeing in panic from the giant alien attack.
Ms. Kobayashi's shop was well regarded by customers for her loving care of flowers, and was always busy with customers buying flowers on their way home from work.

Watching the shop she had cherished for 20 years being crushed before her eyes, Ms. Kobayashi was so shocked that she crouched down and couldn't move.

Yoshio Sasaki, a regular customer living in the ward who happened to witness the scene, said while rubbing his right elbow and shoulder, "People fleeing crashed into Ms. Kobayashi's stall one after another. The stall held up through the first two times, but when it was hit the third time, it was completely crushed. They were crashing into it with considerable force, so there's no way the stall could have held up. It's truly a pity."

We hope Ms. Kobayashi recovers and reopens her flower shop.

entries.en:
Clear umbrellas are now booming among women in their twenties, mainly in metropolitan areas. Clear umbrellas used to be generally seen as cheap, but this year major department stores and apparel makers have one after another introduced brand-name and designer-supervised clear umbrellas and offered variations with finely selectable levels of transparency, apparently winning over female customers.

Akiko Watanuki, a trading company employee living in the city, said, "I love the sheer clarity of clear umbrellas. On rainy days, when I watch the rain dripping through the umbrella, my gloom clears up and I feel refreshed! I have about 20 clear umbrellas with different transparencies. I pick how transparent an umbrella to take depending on my mood that day."

The clear umbrella boom looks set to continue.

entries.en:
An investigation by the National Police Agency has revealed that Senior Officer Yanai and Officer Kuribayashi of the Aokiba-cho police box, under the jurisdiction of Miyato Station, had been growing vegetables for their own consumption on state-owned land behind the police box.
Yanai and Kuribayashi reportedly grew vegetables they liked, such as snow peas and cherry tomatoes, and served them at their own meals nearly every night. Some also believe they even used fertilizer, seriously aiming to increase their harvest.

When questioned, Senior Officer Yanai reportedly said, "I just really wanted one more dish at dinner. At first I started casually, thinking just green onions would be fine. Gradually it escalated, and I got into seasonal vegetables like spinach and snow peas. Once I started growing cherry tomatoes, there was no stopping me. I am truly sorry to the citizens and my fellow officers."

Taking the matter seriously, the National Police Agency intends to tighten controls by adding a ban on home gardens behind police boxes to its work regulations. Senior Officer Yanai received a three-month pay cut, and Officer Kuribayashi a one-month pay cut.

According to eyewitnesses nearby, a young person dodged the overturning bus with swift movements and was unharmed.
Some witnesses also say that part of this young person's body was glowing purple as they dodged the bus.

The alien drove its right arm into the building around the 8th floor and pulled it out. According to someone who watched from outside the building, a young person left on the 8th floor fell from the impact when the alien pulled its arm out, but quickly took a landing stance and was unharmed.

Near the West Azami intersection on Tsubaki Avenue in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, as crowds fled the fighting between giant aliens, a road sign was knocked over when an alien's shin struck it, apparently injuring many people.
According to Mr. M, a city resident who took refuge on the sidewalk and witnessed it, as people were caught under the fallen sign, one young person made their hands glow purple and quickly escaped the falling sign.

Officer Naoko Kuribayashi of the Aokiba-cho police box is guiding evacuations amid this unprecedented situation, calling out to people never to give up and to survive.

The Metropolitan Police Department announced that Yuko Saeki, who had been arrested on suspicion of murdering her brother, has escaped.
Saeki took advantage of an accident during her transport to escape, and with the city in chaos from the giant alien attack, the search has been difficult.
Citizens are being warned to be careful due to Saeki's violent nature.

Meanwhile, there are rumors that a photo appearing to show Saeki has been posted online. The photo shows a person talking with Saeki while she is in handcuffs.
Police are searching for the person seen talking with Saeki.

Young people whose hands glow purple have been sighted one after another in Sakura Ward, Miyato City.
Kazuaki Ikeuchi, who works in the Kaido Building in the ward, speaks with awe of a young person who appeared dashingly inside the building.
"That person's hands glowed purple! And then the alien pulled its hand back."
Chika Kinoshita, who works at the same office, excitedly said, "That's a savior! As long as that person is here, we'll be fine!"

If your ST (stamina) drops, you can safely assume you're in danger.
If your ST reaches 0, you won't be able to dash for a while.
Then you won't be able to run past danger when it counts, making it hard to escape a crisis.
ST recovers if you wait a while after it runs out, but the trick seems to be alternating between dashing and running so it never hits 0.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow TIPS. (Written by Satoko Midorikawa, Giant Shadow News editorial team)

When your health (HP) or stamina (ST) is low, or when you think, "That's enough for today," check any large blue "S" you see nearby.
It's a mysterious space called a "save point."
It instantly restores your health and stamina, and keeps a record so you can resume play partway through the next day.
That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow TIPS. (Written by Satoko Midorikawa, Giant Shadow News editorial team)

entries.en:
Yui Iwabuchi, who works part-time at the Clover Aokiba-cho convenience store in Sakura Ward, is another person affected by the battle of the giant aliens.
Iwabuchi is a huge fan of singer-songwriter Aya Suzumura. That day, she planned to attend a fans-only live show at the radio station late at night, but when her shift ended, the next part-timer hadn't come in, leaving her stuck.
What's more, the student scheduled for the shift after hers had the tickets to the radio station live show and was supposed to give them to her at the store.

As she fretted at closing time, a young person appeared and gladly agreed that if they found the student with the tickets, they would bring them to the radio station.
Iwabuchi said, "I don't know if the tickets will reach me, but I'm not giving up. I'm heading to the radio station."

Will Iwabuchi make it to Aya Suzumura's live show? These strange events are affecting the daily lives of the people in this area.

Horuho Sugita of Miyato City, one such Saiken fan, said, "I thought it would be classic fantasy, but the twists are completely unpredictable, one surprise after another in the best way. And thanks to this novel, I've made lots of Saiken friends all over the world."

Responding to the press, the railway's CEO, Tetsuro Densha, issued a statement saying, "We will do our utmost to restore service as soon as possible."

entries.en: On the 29th of last month, local middle schoolers released young sweetfish into the Hanamomo River, which flows through the city. The release has been held for 12 years and has become an annual tradition. In an interview, Hanamomo Middle School student council president Kaicho Seto (14) said with a smile, "I got to experience the strength of life up close. I'm looking forward to seeing the sweetfish all grown up." Seto is set to leave for a one-year language study program in the United States on the 15th of this month.

Bin'in says, "I was saved because there was a stubborn stain on the office floor."
Bin'in is known for his love of cleanliness, and that day, while scrubbing a stain he'd found on patrol, the wall in front of him suddenly collapsed. Fortunately, Bin'in was unhurt and is now giving a statement to police to explain the situation in detail.

entries.en:
Tonight, the observation ship Shibazakura sank 120 km off the Kokedo Peninsula. According to the Japan Meteorological Agency, the waves in the area were calm at the time. There are also eyewitness reports that just before it sank, a giant creature emerged from the sea and destroyed the ship in an instant, and the Japan Coast Guard is investigating the cause of the sinking.

The Shibazakura was 210.0 m long and 38.0 m wide, with a top speed of 12 knots and a capacity of 150 people. It was mainly used for marine life surveys. People involved say that on this day, the survey schedule had been abruptly extended to study marine life.

entries.en: A Dream Unfulfilled: To Become a Captain and Sail the World's Oceans
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0037.json:p0/k75; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Tetsuya Oda, first mate of the observation ship Shibazakura, said he wanted to one day become a captain like Captain Katagiri and set out across the world's oceans, but he vanished into the sea with that dream unfulfilled.

His younger sister Harumi said, "We lost our parents early and grew up in a relative's home. Since middle school, my brother always gave his all to judo practice and his studies while working part-time. He adored my son, who was born last year. I still can't believe my brother is gone. No matter how hard things got, he was always tenacious and cheerful."
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0037.json:p0/k76; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
【Column by Risa Kashiwagi: Working to Rid the World of Conflict】
Even now, there are regions of the world where people continue to fight out of hatred. Interests clash, ideas of justice clash, and conflicts and fighting go on at this very moment.
So many people want a peaceful world, so why don't wars and conflicts disappear?
In conflict zones around the world, I have seen many children living lives in which they cannot take tomorrow for granted. Meanwhile, I ask myself what I have actually done to end conflict and fighting. In this series, I intend to write about activities for peace that we, too, can take part in.
(Written by journalist Risa Kashiwagi)

entries.en:
It has been decided that a book signing by the author of "The Tale of the Last Sword," known as "Saiken" and loved by diehard fans around the world, will be held in Miyato City.
According to a PR representative, the exact date and time are undecided because the author, O. R. James, is busy, but an announcement is coming soon. The signing venue will reportedly be modeled after the arena that appears in Volume 4.
Past "Saiken" author signings have drawn lines of over 1,000 people, so there's no doubt a fierce "Saiken" whirlwind will sweep through Miyato City as well.

entries.en:
Around 10:30 p.m. today, a huge, mysterious black life form appeared at an intersection on Nanohana Street in Miyato City. The life form destroyed one building after another and shot down three attack aircraft sent to intercept it.
Traffic was jammed near the intersection at the time and many people were on the street, but heat rays from the life form and the burning wreckage of the downed aircraft started fires, causing chaos. According to police, the incident left 20 dead, 10 lightly injured, and 5 seriously injured, and the numbers are expected to rise.
Mr. A, who was at the scene, said, "Everyone was desperate to get away from the giant. People ran while looking behind them and crashed into cars, making things even more chaotic. There were police officers there, but it was impossible for them to guide anyone."
All the pilots aboard the attack aircraft have been confirmed dead.

entries.en:
Around 11:00 p.m. today, a girl who had gone missing in Miyato City appeared before her father and was safely taken into care. She reportedly has no noticeable injuries.
The girl got lost while searching for her older sister in Miyato City, but tonight she appeared with her sister in the room of Benibana Memorial Hospital where her father is hospitalized. The girl is in good spirits and is said to be looking forward to going out to play with her sister. She is currently being examined at the hospital as a precaution.

entries.en:
Anyone can feel lost about what to do when facing difficulties.
At times like that, talking to the person who's always with you might help you break through.
Even if it doesn't, it should at least lift your mood!
Even someone who's usually curt will understand your feelings once you open up to each other.
When you're in trouble, try talking to your companion.

That's all for this edition of Giant Shadow TIPS. (Written by Satoko Midorikawa, Giant Shadow News editorial team)

entries.en:
An attack by an Angel that appeared late tonight caused a taxi parked on the street near a convenience store at the corner of the Nanohana-Mokuren intersection in Sakura Ward to explode and burst into flames. The driver was reading in the convenience store and was unharmed.
Taxi driver Akira Tsuge, who was browsing a travel guide in the store, watched through the glass as his taxi exploded and burst into flames, and couldn't help but look up at the heavens.
Tsuge said in a matter-of-fact tone, "I think it was my fault for browsing in the store for so long. The clerk looked young, so I took advantage of not being told off and read two whole books standing there. When I started on the third, it suddenly got noisy outside, there was a loud boom, and then I saw my taxi explode and go up in flames. If I'd stopped after two books, my car might have been fine."

The first is the finest wristwatch from luxury watchmaker Zoyer, the "Zoyer Donen Sonen Premium." Simply wearing it exudes overwhelming elegance and elevates the wearer's presence.
The second is the "Shimassy Millennium Chronograph" from dedicated dive watch maker Shimassy. It features 9,000 m water resistance for saturation diving and a unidirectional bezel. A superb piece that can even withstand the pressure of the Mariana Trench.
And the third is the "Dekiranke After Five" from watch company Dekiranke, which has released many popular watches.

Why not change your watch and dress up this spring?
The watches introduced here can be obtained in this site's coin exchange corner.
I get 3 percent of the wholesale price whenever you exchange for one, so please do consider it.
(Text: Watch journalist Fumio Tokito)

entries.en:
Benibana Memorial Hospital stands right next to where the mysterious life form, the Angel, fought the giant humanoid weapon.
Even though the hospital is so close to where the strange events took place, many doctors and nurses have not evacuated and are still caring for the injured brought in and the inpatients who cannot evacuate.
Dr. Suzuki, a staff physician, said, "I was off today and at home when the strange events happened, but I knew my colleagues were still here, so I couldn't sit still and came in to work. In a situation like this, I want to do as much as I can right now."
Perhaps their dedication got through, because Benibana Memorial Hospital has miraculously escaped damage.

entries.en:
"I saved up and finally opened my store, so why of all places did it have to be in front of mine..."
Mr. Saito, owner of the convenience store chain branch Clover Mokuren Street, spoke in grief.
The Angel that appeared late tonight descended from the sky onto Nanohana Street and kept destroying the city as it moved south. A giant humanoid weapon emerged from a launch facility on intersecting Mokuren Street, and the two began to fight. That means the battle unfolded right in front of Saito's convenience store.
The store itself suffered no major damage, but the surrounding buildings and roads were destroyed, and with most nearby residents evacuated, customers have stopped coming. Damaged roads have also made it impossible to get deliveries.
Faced with such absurdity, Saito says he feels anger with nowhere to go, and emptiness.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0039.json:p0/k122; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Against the Angel that suddenly appeared on Nanohana Street in Miyato City late tonight, the giant humanoid weapon that appeared next used an extra-large Gatling gun, scattering hundreds of shell casings around the area.
The casings are huge, about 2 m long, and there are reports of damage to cars and nearby buildings that were hit directly.
The large Gatling gun is still lying on the road, and citizens have complained that they want it removed quickly.
The Gatling gun is as large as a three-story building and extremely heavy, making it difficult to remove even with heavy machinery. A contractor asked to dismantle it has reportedly thrown up their hands, saying, "We have no idea how to take it apart."
The local Nanohana-Mokuren Chamber of Commerce, noting its size and visual impact, has reportedly suggested, "Why not leave it as it is and reuse it as a tourist attraction?"

entries.en:
In connection with the incident in which an unknown creature attacked people at the municipal subway's Azami 1-chome Station, the Metropolitan Police Department has sent papers to prosecutors on station master Junichi Isono (58) on suspicion of professional negligence resulting in death, among other charges, for fleeing the station without taking proper evacuation measures for passengers. Isono reportedly broadly admits the charges.

Isono, who was the first to flee the station, leaving dozens of passengers behind, changed into plain clothes while escaping and falsely claimed to be "an ordinary citizen" when rescued. He has been harshly condemned online at home and abroad as "a disgrace to station staff."
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0041.json:p0/k100; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Today, Ryohei Ogita (23), an office worker in Sumire Ward, was meeting Yukana Suga (26), his girlfriend from the same workplace, on the platform at Azami 1-chome Station.

Around 7:00 p.m., while the train was stopped at Azami 1-chome Station, the power in the car suddenly went out. Just as he wondered what was happening, he saw the conductor's cabin next door splattered with blood.
His body moved before he could think. Ogita was the first to flee the train. Several small Legion were already on the platform. He narrowly slipped past them, ran up to the ticket gates, and hid in the men's restroom.

Once he calmed down, Ogita couldn't stop worrying about Suga. But he was too terrified to move. Then an unfamiliar young man came and held out a ring, asking if he recognized it. It was without a doubt the ring Ogita had given Suga. He was told a woman hiding in the women's restroom next door had it. When he called Suga's name loudly, she answered. Keeping the joy of their reunion brief, the two worked together to escape the underground mall.

"Not knowing what situation I was in, the time I spent hiding alone felt very long," says Ogita. What on earth is happening in Miyato City now? A swift investigation and disclosure of information are needed.

entries.en:
The underground mall suffered severe damage from the series of giant plants and unknown creatures, and thefts taking advantage of the situation have been frequent. At a jewelry store in particular, rubies, sapphires, and other gems were stolen, with losses reaching 1 billion yen.

Among them, the giant emerald known as the "Tear of Spirogyra" is a costly gem worth 400 million yen on its own, and store owner Mr. Okamoto laments, "I just want the Tear of Spirogyra back, at least."
Police have begun questioning people to find the culprit who stole the giant emerald "Tear of Spirogyra."
Since a woman was seen breaking a showcase and rummaging through the gems, police are searching for her as a person of interest.

entries.en:
The area around the Umegaya intersection in Sakura Ward was devastated by unknown creatures that came up from inside Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line.
Firefighters and riot police had been dispatched to the area to deal with a giant plant that had taken hold of the Akashia Department Store, but they were attacked by swarms of mysterious creatures, apparently injuring many citizens and personnel.

Above all, changing your clothes changes your mood.
If you're in a difficult position, changing clothes can be very effective.

entries.en:
Inside Azami 1-chome subway station in Sakura Ward, an attack by unknown creatures has caused devastating damage.
Amid this, people gathered near the ticket gates were seen helping one another, anxious but holding on to hope of escape.
Mr. Morimoto, a ward resident, was caught up in the strange events on his way to his part-time job at a convenience store in Aokiba-cho, but he entrusted the late-night live show tickets meant for a coworker to a young person heading for the radio station.
Morimoto reportedly said, "I'm going to do my best to get out of here and go to work. But if I take the live tickets with me, they won't make it in time, so hoping my coworker is heading to the radio station venue, I entrusted the tickets to someone going there."

entries.en:
"Pure Café Yamagobo," in the underground mall at Azami 1-chome Station on the Yotsuba subway line, had been operating there for 40 years, since the subway opened, but these strange events have brought its history to a close.
Mr. Okamoto, a jewelry store owner and childhood friend of the café's master, said, "The master here was always calm, no matter what. Even when I installed a number lock on the café as a prank, he didn't get angry and just silently kept polishing coffee cups."

entries.en:
The giant monster that destroyed Miyato Sky Tower is believed to have been targeting the Gyaos nest.
 
The Gyaos had appeared in flocks on Suzuran Avenue, leaving many injured and missing.
 Meanwhile, experts have suggested that the giant monster may be the same individual that appeared at the Umegaya intersection.
 
 In light of this, about the giant monster,
 "If it was targeting the monsters that were attacking people, isn't it a creature that's friendly to humans?"
 is one opinion that has been voiced.
 
 On the other hand,
 "It destroyed Miyato Sky Tower and caused damage all around it. Even if the giant monster drove off the flying monsters, that's unforgivable."
 is a negative opinion that has also been voiced.
 
 The debate over whether the giant monster is humanity's enemy or ally looks set to continue.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0064.json:p0/k124; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
It has emerged that Dr. Yasuke Komada, an authority in biology, was on the observation deck of Miyato Sky Tower.
On the observation deck, the doctor observed the vomit spat out by the Gyaos, noticed that they have a habit of regurgitating things they cannot digest, and says he wants to begin research based on vomit samples after his escape.

The doctor has uncovered the secrets of various creatures with his outlandish drive.
What made him famous above all was entering a living whale through its mouth and conducting three days of field research inside its body, using its stomach as his base.
Of course, he paid attention to the whale's health, and it was confirmed to be living happily after he came out.
At first the academic world dismissed him, but his research inside the whale later led to a drug that completely cures human cancer with a 98% success rate, earning him worldwide praise. The story of the academic bigwigs of the time doing a complete about-face and making "pilgrimages to the doctor" to apologize at his home was widely covered back then.

entries.en:
Kosuke Esaka (pseudonym), a worker at Miyato Sky Tower, saw a coworker eaten by a Gyaos right in front of him.
Esaka (pseudonym) barely managed to escape, but the psychological shock was so severe that he is still hospitalized, unable to lead a normal life.

The coworker was the older brother of Esaka's (pseudonym) fiancée, and they had known each other for about five years. People around them said they were like close brothers.

Esaka's (pseudonym) fiancée, enduring this tragedy just a month before their wedding, is said to be devotedly caring for him.

entries.en:
Miyato Sky Tower was designed by the great master Shunzo Sanuki.
His designs, meticulous down to the smallest detail, extend even to the men's restroom on the observation deck.
Amazingly, every toilet there was handmade by him. Records show he built a dedicated kiln for this and mixed everything himself, down to the special clay and glaze.
They were so finely made that other facilities begged for them too, but Sanuki flatly refused, saying, "These toilets are made specifically for this men's restroom and are fit for nowhere else," so even today they can be seen only here.
And because they were appraised at a staggering 2 billion yen, Miyato Sky Tower tried to prohibit their use, which enraged Sanuki. How it happened is unclear, but in the end they remained available for normal use.

The Sky Tower keeps dedicated staff stationed there to keep watch, and they carefully polish the toilets when no one is using them.

Since Sanuki has passed away and no records of his clay or glaze formulas remain, their value has risen even further; some say they are now worth 6 billion yen.

We sincerely hope the day will come when we can sit once again on these super-ultra-expensive toilets, which escaped damage in this incident as well.

entries.en:
The toilets in the women's restroom of Miyato Sky Tower are the work of Sayoko, wife of the great master Shunzo Sanuki.
Sayoko, every bit as skilled as her husband Shunzo Sanuki, made them as the only work created as a pair with her husband, making them extremely rare.
(Her husband, Mr. Sanuki, made the toilets in the Sky Tower's men's restroom.)
At first glance, they look identical to Mr. Sanuki's toilets, but everything from the clay and glaze to the firing method is completely different.
When Sanuki later said in an interview, "Sayoko is the one person I can never beat," the line was widely covered at the time.

Shunzo Sanuki and Sayoko were both designers, yet they competed for the top in everything related to architecture. Even experts still puzzle over how they became so versatile.

Incidentally, these toilets are appraised at 10 billion yen. Partly because of Sanuki's remark above, they are valued higher than her husband's work.

entries.en:
How many people know that the site where Miyato Sky Tower stands was once the grounds of the home of famous entrepreneur Heishiro Tadokoro?

Heishiro Tadokoro was a man who started one new business after another during the postwar turmoil and achieved great success within a single generation.
Several business books have been written about him.
At the time, he lived on grounds 30 times the size of the Miyato Sky Tower site.
But what made Heishiro Tadokoro remarkable is that he did not simply show off his success with vast grounds and a luxurious house.
He built an entire "town" on his grounds and offered it free of charge to war orphans and people with nowhere else to go.
He gave work to those who wanted it, and paid them wages so they could become independent.
Those who became able to support themselves to some extent, once they could pay their own rent, began living just outside Heishiro's grounds.

When everyone had become independent, Heishiro donated all of his land to the nation.
The land was then redeveloped into the streets we know today.
It is said that Heishiro afterward lived in seclusion deep in the mountains somewhere, but whether that's true is uncertain.

entries.en:
Do you know what stood before the war where Miyato Sky Tower now stands?

It was an era when foreign culture was beginning to reach ordinary people, and few people yet wore Western clothes.
A large inn once stood here.
It was of course a wooden building, but at five stories, it could be called a high-rise for its time.
The owner of this inn enjoyed great prosperity by dabbling in all kinds of wrongdoing, using the inn as his base.

With strong connections to police and important government figures, he escaped punishment for his crimes.
But once the war began, that splendid building instead became a conspicuous target.
It was soon reduced to scorched earth, and the documents and evidence that were the weak points of those important figures turned to ash too.

No one reached out to the innkeeper who had lost everything; instead, he was arrested and executed for running an illegal business.
It is said this was to silence him so he wouldn't say anything inconvenient.

No one could have imagined that Heishiro Tadokoro, who reached out to people, would later come to live on that same land.

entries.en:
A motorcycle stolen on the Sky Garden Bridge has been found on a street near Hinageshidai Station.

It had been taken apart when it was found, and the investigation is considering the possibility of a prankster.
Giant creatures were sighted near where it was found, and police say they are "diligently investigating," including the possibility that they were responsible.

The owner, Shizuo Sato (pseudonym), answered the interview looking dejected: "I still have two years left on the loan..."

entries.en:
This car, crumpled and completely burned, was parked right behind a tanker truck when the truck exploded from a giant creature's strange beam, and was caught in the blast.
The owner, Shigehisa Kano (28) (pseudonym), had come that day to pick up his girlfriend on their first anniversary.
He parked in front of the building that houses her private office, but when he entered the office, she was with another man and told him Kano was a stalker. Since the other man was connected to the Metropolitan Police Department, Kano was immediately taken to a nearby station.
The police refused to listen to Kano's protests that he was not a stalker, and he was finally released only after signing a pledge not to approach her again.
When Kano returned, bewildered and exhausted, his car was in a wretched state dozens of meters from where he had left it.
"...Did I... do something wrong...?" We could find no words for Kano as he murmured this.

According to some testimony gathered in our reporting, she had let slip, "I can't squeeze any more money out of him, so I need to find the next one."

entries.en:
This time, we talk with Tatsuya Konoe (28), who works at the much-talked-about Hinageshidai Station.
Interviewer (I): "Mr. Konoe, how many years have you been a station attendant?"
Konoe (K): "A little over a year."
I: "What did you do before that?"
K: "I started an internet company while I was in university, and after graduating I kept running the company."
I: "So, it stopped going well?"
K: "No, sales were growing steadily."
I: "Then why become a station attendant? Was it your childhood dream?"
K: "I'd made more money than I could spend even if I goofed off until I was 100, so I got bored. So I wrote a program with a simple algorithm that randomly displays a job, ran it, and it said station attendant, so I got hired through an acquaintance."
I: "Um, so you're not particularly attached to the job of station attendant?"K: "You could say I'm attached to it in the sense that it's fun. When I watch people desperately commuting back and forth every day on meager pay or tiny allowances, I feel sorry for them, but it's also amusing, isn't it?"

To be continued next time.

entries.en:
Surprising information has come in about Katsuko Mitarai (38), a relief activist often seen on TV for defending and aiding the living conditions and human rights of various people considered vulnerable.
This photo was taken inside Hinageshidai Station. It clearly shows Mitarai pressing a station attendant about something.
Astonishingly, Mitarai was demanding that the attendant close the station's shutters. This was even though two giant creatures had appeared nearby and many people were still trying to escape. According to the member of the public who took this photo, Mitarai was pouting and insisting the shutters be closed, all so that no harm would come to herself. She did offer the excuse that it would help the people who had already fled to safety, but objectively, it looked like she was fixated only on protecting herself.
They say people show their true nature in a crisis; is this the real Mitarai?
Am I the only one who, thinking about it, suddenly finds her activities suspicious?

entries.en: Functional Desk "Karukaru"
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k181; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Good news for companies that frequently move desks as flexible organizational structures spread.
The functional desk "Karukaru" is made of a special fiber, Tetofanu, and is hollow inside, so it weighs an ultra-light 100 grams. The air inside is pressure-managed throughout by a built-in computer, so there's no risk of it deforming like a balloon even when you put your hands or heavy objects on it.
And since you can let the air out, you can carry a whole desk in your shirt pocket.

You might think something that light would slide around and be hard to use, but it sucks air up from under its legs, so it grips even carpeted floors and feels just like an ordinary desk.

Just one thing: please be aware that it costs electricity.

entries.en:
The coin lockers at Hinageshidai Station lead to a secret underground facility.
Have you ever heard that rumor?
They say if you open the coin lockers in a certain order and say certain words in front of a certain locker, a passage appears behind the lockers and leads underground.
It is supposedly a facility for certain bigwigs to take refuge in an emergency.

When we asked the company that operates the station, they replied that no such thing exists, politely showing us the blueprints.

But I saw it. In the middle of the giant creature commotion, I witnessed prefectural assemblyman Kamozo Gokita slipping behind the coin lockers, and when I went closer, there was indeed a passage just big enough for one person.
I tried to go inside, but a man in black suddenly appeared in front of me, and sensing danger, I hastily fled.

In fact, as I type this article, I can hear someone outside the office trying to get in.
If I manage to escape, I will continue my reporting and bring you the truth.

entries.en:
Did you know that the door of the station attendants' office at Hinageshidai Station was made by Toshiya, third son of the great master Shunzo Sanuki?
It is the first door Toshiya ever made, back when he was just starting out. Toshiya is not an all-round designer like his father Shunzo Sanuki, but is highly regarded as an objet sculptor. He currently works only as an objet sculptor, but since he excels at many things just like his father, many voices hope he will eventually follow the same path as his father.

That door, made while Toshiya was helping with his father's work at a time when he hadn't yet found his own direction, is now appraised at 300 million yen.
Its rarity comes from the fact that it is the only architectural piece he has ever made, before or since.

Like father, like son, perhaps?

entries.en:
This time, we of the "Society for Admiring Elevators" visited the elevator of the "Yukiyanagi Building."
This elevator was not made by an ordinary contractor, but specially designed by none other than Shunzo Sanuki.
Sanuki had already retired, but because he was close friends with the building's owner, he designed this masterpiece.

As you may already know, the word "compromise" does not exist for Sanuki. So the on-site workers were reportedly made to redo the work over and over. But what makes Sanuki amazing is that it didn't end there: the people made to redo the work improved dramatically from then on, and are now aces and technical advisors at major construction firms, all saying, "Studying under Sanuki back then was what started it all."

entries.en:
Toro, familiar from "Doko Demo Issyo," was reportedly sighted near Hinageshidai Station.
According to witnesses, he seemed to be troubled by something.
It is unclear whether he was bewildered by the current commotion like everyone else, or whether there was another reason.
It also can't be ruled out that Toro is connected to the commotion and was worrying because things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.

Since there were also sightings of Toro having some sort of exchange with a young person inside a vehicle abandoned on the road,
I intend to continue my reporting to identify that young person and reveal the truth.

"The Tale of the Last Sword," a novel loved across nations and races, is now on sale in every member state of the United Nations. The famous phrase "Honerarino Funarama" will be read all over the world.
In every language, not only professional translators but also many diehard fans volunteered to translate, allowing its grand and moving story to cross language barriers and reach people's hearts.
Most world leaders also love this novel, and the many requests to the author and publisher to "please sell it in our country too" are thought to be a major factor in this achievement.

entries.en:
In Mizuna City, where a giant Angel appeared, huge walls rose up from the ground in the urban area. Dozens of walls rose, forming a huge slope. Nearby houses collapsed as the walls rose, among other damage.
Residents around the walls are reportedly forming a victims' association to protest to the government and local authorities. So far, the government has made no announcement about the walls.

The walls rose as a giant humanoid weapon was approaching the giant Angel that had appeared in the sky. Military journalist Mr. Misatoya, an expert on weapons, said, "I don't know the details, but perhaps it was a facility that turned the huge slope into a track so the humanoid weapon wouldn't lose running speed."

entries.en:
Before dawn today, an intruder broke into a milk shop on the Mizuna shopping street in Mizuna City and stole earrings worth about 6 million yen.
The stolen earrings belonged to Mr. and Mrs. Horiuchi, who run the milk shop, and were a keepsake.
Milk deliveries had been delayed that day by the giant creature incident that began the day before, and the intruder is believed to have entered while the Horiuchis were outside the shop.
Police believe the crime was committed by an acquaintance who knew the Horiuchis owned expensive earrings, and are questioning people in the area.

entries.en:
【Column by Risa Kashiwagi: Endure the Strange Events, and Don't Give Up on Ending Conflict】
Right now, in this country, and around Miyato City where I live, people's lives are threatened by giant shadows.
And looking abroad, conflicts and fighting still continue. If we give up in the face of threats, or give up on a world without conflict and fighting ever coming, we will lose sight of the direction in which to live.

I believe that each person standing by what they think is right is the source of the strength to survive these strange events and to rid the world of conflict and fighting.
In some cases, your judgment, or what you are trying to do, may be criticized. Even so, I believe that always trying to choose, from among the many options, what you truly think is right, what you truly want to choose, will create a world where everyone can live happily.

In my next column, I plan to write about what I am thinking now, and what I am trying to do. (Written by journalist Risa Kashiwagi)

As we reported, before dawn today a runaway car tried to run over citizens in Mizuna City.
But astonishingly, this car not only tried to run people over, it also destroyed a "dresser" left on the road.
The dresser's owner, Su Tan (85), is furious: "Strange things are happening everywhere, so I was planning to pack my savings, food, and clothes into the dresser from my house and evacuate to a relative's place. That runaway car ruined everything." Police are investigating on suspicion of property damage.

Before dawn today, a young person appeared at a milk shop on the Mizuna shopping street in Mizuna City and handed earrings to Mr. and Mrs. Horiuchi, who run the shop.
The earrings the young person gave the couple were a keepsake of Mr. Horiuchi's mother, who passed away four years ago.
The expensive earrings, worth about 6 million yen, had been dropped in front of the shop, where the young person found them and brought them to the couple.
Milk deliveries had been delayed that day by the giant creature incident that began the day before, and while the Horiuchis were outside the shop, the young person handed them the earrings and left without giving a name.

Nearby residents have been sending in report after report that Labors are fighting fiercely at Asaseo Wharf today.
The Metropolitan Police Department announced that, while identifying the affiliation and identity of those Labors, it has urgently dispatched police Labors and moved to bring the scene under control.

entries.en:
The Ingram, dispatched after reports of an unidentified black Labor appearing at Asaseo Wharf, has once again caused needless damage to its surroundings.
What's more, it wasn't in combat: it simply stumbled while moving and bumped into a warehouse wall as if leaning on it.
Amid voices in town saying its pilot should start over from the beginner's course, the police are still declining to comment.

I saw something incredible during the battle between Labors at Asaseo Wharf.
When the black Labor defeated a number of Abrahams and one of them got back up, a woman was seen piloting the Abraham.
Before that, there were also eyewitness reports that the young person who boarded it wasn't an insider, and the view that they may be civilians is growing stronger.

I will continue my reporting and report back as soon as there are developments.

I saw something incredible during the battle between Labors at Asaseo Wharf.
When the black Labor defeated a number of Abrahams and one of them got back up, a young person was seen piloting the Abraham.
Before that, there were also eyewitness reports that the woman who boarded it wasn't an insider, and the view that they may be civilians is growing stronger.

I will continue my reporting and report back as soon as there are developments.

entries.en:
A scene at Asaseo Wharf, where the black Labor appeared.
The worker in the photo called his family home despite the late hour and asked them to record the news.
His reasoning was that when news helicopters broadcast live because of the black Labor's appearance, if he showed up on screen he could brag to everyone.
This phenomenon of causing trouble for others in order to "show off" is increasing every year, and cases leading to incidents are soaring.
We can only pray this worker's case doesn't go that far

entries.en:
We were able to enter the wheelhouse of the fishing boat owned by Yahei Shinozaki, a man of the sea known to those in the know.
The moment I stepped in, the air was thick with a passion that even a layman like me could feel.
Shinozaki took up fishing at 16 and has devoted his life to the sea, spending most of it on the water.
Many of his great feats are known to the public, but some have gone untold because they are so unusual.
For those, please see "The Soul of Yahei," to be published soon.

It has come to light that a member of the public with an abnormal interest in forklifts visited Asaseo Wharf.
This person was obsessed with driving a forklift no matter what, and ended up driving one without permission.
However, the forklift itself was abandoned in a nearby warehouse with no damage, so the owner commented that for now they do not intend to report it as a theft.
Was it the work of an enthusiast who suddenly felt like driving a forklift in the middle of the night?
If the mystery is ever solved, we'll bring you a follow-up.

entries.en:
The warehouse-visit series by this writer, who loves warehouses more than anything. This time, I was able to tour a warehouse at Asaseo Wharf.
A few days after this tour, that commotion happened, and I was shocked to learn that all sorts of illegal goods had been stored in these warehouses.
That's because the person who showed me around that day was very kind, and I didn't sense that kind of underworld atmosphere in the warehouse at all.
Perhaps such cargo just wasn't kept in the warehouse I was shown.

The warehouses themselves are not to blame. I want to keep visiting warehouses.

entries.en:
A worker sleeping slumped over a desk in a control room inside a warehouse at Asaseo Wharf.
At first, I thought it was exhaustion from constant unfair overtime and interviewed him, only to find that wasn't the case.
He had never worked overtime; he was simply short on sleep from playing games at home all the time, and was slacking off and napping where no one was watching.

He got into his parents' company through connections, and because of that, his superiors have trouble telling him off.
In this commotion, it came to light that the company had also been involved in wrongdoing.
The employees have scattered, and he is no exception.
Will he be able to survive in society without his parents' backing? Please wait for our follow-up.

In the case of the warehouse explosion and fire at Asaseo Wharf, we obtained footage capturing what appears to be the bomb that triggered the explosion.

The warehouse explosion was said to be a result of the battle between Labors, but it seems that wasn't the case: it was deliberately destroyed.
Why, by whom, and for what purpose remain unexplained.
I intend to keep chasing this mystery.

entries.en:
It has been found that a boat reported stolen was abandoned at Asaseo Wharf.
Since the boat's owner was threatened with what looked like a gun and the boat was taken by two men, police judged it likely to be a crime, and their swift search led to its discovery.

There is also eyewitness testimony that the men who took the boat fired shots near the wharf where they abandoned it, and police are now working to determine their whereabouts and identities.
We will report as soon as there is more news.

Omoto Trading purchased 10 new warehouses at Asaseo Wharf and now occupies about 80% of the wharf's warehouses.
This allows it to handle even more distribution.

In this feature, we present last fiscal year's top 10 news stories from Omoto Trading, famous for owning many warehouses at Asaseo Wharf and handling the distribution of all kinds of goods. Part 2: "Launch of TV Shopping."

Omoto Trading at last launched 24-hour TV shopping as a broadcaster with its own nationwide dedicated channel.
It is drawing attention by having famous top-tier actors and actresses appear, matched to the time slot and products.
Also, every day one of its products is offered at a rock-bottom price of 1,000 yen regardless of profit, and ratings are skyrocketing.

entries.en:
In this feature, we present last fiscal year's top 10 news stories from Omoto Trading, famous for owning many warehouses at Asaseo Wharf and handling the distribution of all kinds of goods. Part 3: "Warehouses Secured in Every Country."

As a logistics company, Omoto Trading now owns its own warehouses in every country in the world.
Many companies own warehouses in the so-called major countries, but this is the first company to set up, purchase, and own warehouses in every country, regardless of size or level of development.

Asked whether there is really any benefit, Omoto Trading's president answered with a smile.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0079.json:p0/k182; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
In this feature, we present last fiscal year's top 10 news stories from Omoto Trading, famous for owning many warehouses at Asaseo Wharf and handling the distribution of all kinds of goods. Part 4: "Satellite Warehouse Begins Operation."

The satellite warehouse, which can dock cargo and even whole containers carried up from the ground to a space station-like satellite, has finally begun operation.
Omoto Trading accomplished, with its wealth of personnel and assets, a project that would normally be undertaken at the national level.
Container launch costs are still high, but since it requires no land on the ground and can transport goods without ordinary means like ships or trucks, it is a very promising business for the future.
Dedicated launch sites have already been built near the company's warehouses around the world, and requests are reportedly increasing steadily.

In this feature, we present last fiscal year's top 10 news stories from Omoto Trading, famous for owning many warehouses at Asaseo Wharf and handling the distribution of all kinds of goods. Part 5: "Employees Surpass 100 Million."

Omoto Trading's full-time employees have finally exceeded 100 million.
Including part-timers, the number actually exceeds 250 million. Omoto Trading is now welcomed in every country for providing so many people with a place to work.

On the grounds of Omoto Trading's headquarters stands a cherry tree planted by the company's founder, and it has finally reached 1,000 years of age. This also means that Omoto Trading has celebrated its 1,000th anniversary.
Despite being a company with such a long history, its president says, "We aim for our 10,000th anniversary."
